# Image Evaluator
> 生产级多维图像生成评测工具库，覆盖美学质量、语义对齐、主体保真、成对失真、分布差异与人类偏好 9 大核心评测指标。

## 文档索引
- [Overview & Quickstart](/): Production-grade multidimensional evaluation toolkit for AI image generation
- [Aesthetic (Visual Quality Score)](/single-image/aesthetic): Aesthetic Predictor V2 - Zero-reference aesthetic evaluation with OpenCLIP ViT-L-14
- [CLIP Score (Text-Image Alignment)](/single-image/clip): Objective cosine similarity in multimodal embedding space via clip-vit-base-patch32
- [ArcFace (Subject Identity Fidelity)](/single-image/arcface): Face identity cosine distance evaluation via InsightFace buffalo_l 512-dimensional embeddings
- [LPIPS (Perceptual Distance)](/pairwise/lpips): Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity using AlexNet multi-scale deep features
- [SSIM (Structural Similarity)](/pairwise/ssim): Structural Similarity Index Measure via 11x11 Gaussian window decomposition
- [PSNR (Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio)](/pairwise/psnr): Pixel-level reconstruction fidelity computed from Mean Squared Error
- [FID (Fréchet Inception Distance)](/distribution/fid): Generative distribution distance evaluated in Inception-v3 pool3 feature space
- [KID (Kernel Inception Distance)](/distribution/kid): Polynomial kernel Maximum Mean Discrepancy unbiased U-statistic for small-sample evaluation
- [PickScore (Human Preference Alignment)](/preference/pickscore): Fine-tuned CLIP ViT-H-14 scoring model trained on large-scale human choice data
- [Visual Benchmark (Interactive Demo)](/benchmark/visual-demo): Interactive multi-metric dashboard and dual-image slider comparative inspection

## 命令行使用范例
```bash
# 1. 单图视觉美学评分
image-evaluator --metrics aesthetic --image path/to/sample.png

# 2. 图文对齐与人类偏好评分
image-evaluator --metrics clip pickscore \
    --image path/to/sample.png \
    --prompt "a photograph of an astronaut riding a horse on mars"

# 3. 成对图像保真度评估 (LPIPS, SSIM, PSNR)
image-evaluator --metrics lpips ssim psnr \
    --image path/to/generated.png \
    --reference path/to/reference.png

# 4. 数据集分布距离评测 (FID, KID)
image-evaluator --metrics fid kid \
    --image path/to/generated_folder/ \
    --reference path/to/real_folder/

```
